responsibility: This file implements small raw-memory utility routines for the mc-boot runtime. It provides explicit byte/word copy and zero-fill procedures over arbitrary addresses, operating below the string and storage abstractions as simple low-level helpers for modules that need direct region manipulation without depending on richer library services.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the executable implementation of the GMemUtils pair: it contains the actual word-and-byte loops for MemCopy and MemZero, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GMemUtils.h only publishes those routine signatures for other files to call.
